jobs.title: Proposal & Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
Responding to RFPs is a critical aspect of Assurant’s business, and the proposal coordinator plays a critical role managing RFP intake, as well as response authoring, revision, completion and delivery.
Key Objectives
- Increase win rate by developing and executing clear, client-focused win strategies for every RFP.
- Ensure on-time, high-quality submissions that are fully compliant and tailored to client requirements.
- Strengthen competitive differentiation by delivering compelling, insight-led proposals that clearly articulate Assurant’s value proposition.
- Drive cross-functional accountability by aligning stakeholders to defined roles, deadlines, and deliverables.
- Improve proposal efficiency and cycle time through standardized processes, tools, and best practices.
- Enhance content quality and consistency by managing reusable assets and ensuring messaging alignment across responses.
- Embed governance and performance tracking using KPIs (e.g., win rate, turnaround time, quality scores) to continuously improve outcomes.
- Increase stakeholder engagement and effectiveness through structured collaboration, clear communication, and proactive issue resolution.
- Identify and implement process improvements to scale the proposal function and support business growth.

Primary Job Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

30% Win Strategy & Proposal Leadership
- Own the development and execution of RFP win plans, ensuring each response is aligned to client priorities, competitive positioning, and Assurant’s strategic objectives.
- Translate complex requirements into clear, compelling, and differentiated narratives that increase probability of win.
- Challenge and guide stakeholders to ensure contributions are strategic, relevant, and aligned to the overall value proposition.

30% End-to-End RFP Ownership
- Lead the full lifecycle of RFP responses—from intake qualification through to final submission—with clear accountability for quality, timeliness, and completeness.
- Ensure all requirements are met while maintaining a sharp focus on differentiation and client impact.
- Oversee the creation of integrated deliverables (proposals, presentations, personas, videos, etc.) that reinforce the win strategy.

20% Cross-Functional Leadership & Accountability
- Act as the single point of accountability across Marketing and enterprise stakeholders for all RFP activities.
- Align 10–50+ contributors to clear roles, deadlines, and deliverables—holding teams accountable to commitments.
- Facilitate working sessions that drive decisions, resolve blockers, and maintain momentum toward submission.
- Capture and communicate clear actions, decisions, and ownership, ensuring follow-through and execution discipline.
- Proactively influence senior stakeholders to maintain focus on priorities and deliver high-quality inputs on time.

10% Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
- Own and evolve the RFP management process, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and consistency across submissions.
- Drive adoption of proposal management tools and best practices to improve speed, quality, and collaboration.
- Identify and implement improvements based on performance insights (e.g., cycle time, win rates, stakeholder feedback).
- Establish and track KPIs to measure proposal effectiveness and inform ongoing optimization.

10 % Stakeholder & Relationship Management (20%)
- Build strong, trusted relationships across functions to enable effective collaboration and high-quality contributions.
- Act as a strategic partner to stakeholders—anticipating needs, surfacing risks early, and driving alignment.
- Represent Marketing with credibility and clarity, ensuring a consistent and professional engagement model.
- Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous feedback across teams.

Required Experience, Skills, and Knowledge
- Three to five (3-5) years of experience managing complex, multi-pronged projects with 10-50 stakeholders
- Extremely organized with an instinct for thinking on one’s feet and finding solutions on the fly
- Comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and collaborating with the multiple people and personalities behind the work
- Comfortable and confident enough to communicate with senior colleagues on a daily basis, helping them focus as needed, and facilitating the timely delivery of their deliverables
- Interest in growing into a role in project management and/or organizational dynamics, with a passion for finding efficiencies in the way teams operate on a day-to-day basis
- Interest in marketing, business strategy and/or persuasive writing also helpful

jobs.title: Senior Data & Reporting Analyst, Finance (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Overview of Position
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data & Reporting Analyst to build, automate, and maintain data and business intelligence solutions for the Renters Insurance Financial Planning & Analysis team. This role serves as the primary technical owner of reporting and analytical solutions, translating FP&A reporting and analytical requirements into scalable technical solutions through data acquisition, validation, modeling, reporting, automation, and analysis.
Approximately 70-80% of the role focuses on data, reporting, business intelligence, analytics, and technical solution development, while the remaining portion is dedicated to understanding financial and business context. This position offers significant autonomy and ownership, allowing the analyst to influence decision-making, enhance reporting capabilities, drive automation initiatives, and explore the application of AI and emerging technologies within Finance.

What makes us different?
- Significant autonomy and ownership of reporting and analytical solutions from end to end.
- Opportunity to directly influence how data is leveraged for business and financial decision-making.
- Empowerment to recommend new analyses, process improvements, and scalable reporting solutions.
- Exposure to innovative technologies, including AI-driven solutions within Finance.
- Collaborative environment partnering with Finance, technology teams, and business stakeholders.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?
- Translate FP&A reporting and analytical requirements into technical solutions that support actuals, budgets, forecasts, revenue, expenses, profitability, operational metrics, and KPIs.
- Explore, understand, and maintain knowledge of databases, data warehouses, reporting environments, business rules, and data dependencies.
- Assess data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and fitness for purpose.
- Extract, combine, validate, and reconcile data from multiple sources.
- Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and maintain recurring reporting solutions and ad hoc analytical tools.
- Design, build, enhance, and support Power BI dashboards, data models, measures, and reporting solutions.
- Explore and integrate AI solutions into reporting and analytics development processes.
- Recommend reporting enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and scalable solutions.
- Document data sources, calculations, assumptions, controls, lineage, and operating procedures.
- Partner with data owners and technology teams while maintaining ownership of FP&A reporting and analytics deliverables.

What are the requirements needed for this position?
- 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting development, and analytics.
- Advanced SQL experience in a professional environment.
- Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including report development and data modeling.
- Advanced Excel skills for analysis, validation, financial modeling, and reporting.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal.
- Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
- Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?
- Experience with DAX, Power Query, testing, deployment, performance optimization, and production support within Power BI.
- Experience with Alteryx, Python, or similar tools for data preparation, integration, automation, and analysis.
- Exposure to financial planning systems, ERP platforms, general ledger data, or transaction-level data.
- Experience automating recurring reporting and analytical workflows.
- Experience supporting FP&A, Finance, Accounting, Commercial Analytics, Operations Analytics, or other data-driven business functions.
- Ability to interpret results, identify opportunities for deeper analysis, and recommend practical process improvements.
- Experience in insurance, financial services, or another data-intensive industry.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?
General office demands.

How much should I expect to travel?
No regular travel is expected for this position.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Manager - Insights
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Analytics Manager – Insights to lead a team responsible for turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leaders, internal business partners, and external client audiences. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can guide analysts, work directly in the data, shape ambiguous business questions, and deliver trusted insights that influence decisions.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

You will lead a small team of analysts whose work supports business performance, client relationships, operational strategy, and executive-level decision-making. You will balance people leadership, analytics delivery, stakeholder prioritization, and the continued modernization of the team’s reporting and insight capabilities.

Lead analytics delivery and decision support
- Lead analytical projects end to end, including problem framing, project planning, data discovery, analysis, validation, insight development, and recommendation delivery.
- Translate open-ended business questions from internal leaders and client-facing teams into a clear analytical approach, data plan, and measurable answer.
- Use data to identify trends, root causes, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers across business operations, client portfolios, and strategic priorities.
- Present complex findings to senior leaders and external client audiences in plain language, with a clear “so what,” recommended actions, and business implications.
- Own the quality of what leaves the team, including accuracy, reconciliation, reproducibility, documentation, and consistency of every number shared with clients or executives.

Lead, coach, and develop the team
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts, setting clear goals, expectations, priorities, and standards for quality and delivery.
- Provide regular feedback, conduct performance and development conversations, and help analysts grow their technical depth, business judgment, communication, and stakeholder impact.
- Review analytical approaches, SQL, data models, dashboards, and recommendations to raise the level of the work, not just check completion.
- Manage workload and capacity across competing priorities, assigning work based on business value, urgency, skills, and development opportunities.
- Support hiring, onboarding, retention, and talent development across the broader Data Analytics organization.

Build scalable analytics practices, governance, and platforms
- Drive standardization, automation, and reuse of recurring reporting, dashboards, semantic models, datasets, and analytical assets so the team spends more time on insight and less time on manual assembly.
- Advance data modeling, metric definition, documentation, quality controls, and governance best practices across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related analytics environments.
- Partner with Data Engineering, IT, Security, business teams, and other analytics groups to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, well-documented, and production-ready.
- Establish practical standards for data privacy, access controls, testing, release readiness, issue resolution, and responsible use of AI-assisted analytics tools.
- Identify opportunities to modernize legacy reports, reduce duplication, improve performance, and increase adoption of trusted, governed self-service analytics.

Manage stakeholder intake and grow analytics impact
- Own intake and prioritization for the team’s work, making tradeoffs visible and aligning requests to business value, urgency, capacity, and leadership priorities.
- Proactively engage internal and client-facing teams to identify analytical needs before they arrive as requests and shape them into high-value use cases.
- Stay current with trends in insurance, protection and support services, analytics, BI technology, Microsoft Fabric, and responsible AI adoption, bringing forward what is worth testing or scaling.

What will success look like in this role?

In your first 90 days
- You understand the team, the business partners, the reporting portfolio, the data estate, and the highest-value decision points the team supports.
- You have established a clear intake and prioritization rhythm, and stakeholders understand how decisions are made.
- You are reviewing critical outputs for quality, clarity, and business relevance before they reach senior leaders or clients.

By six months
- The quality and consistency of the team’s work has visibly improved through stronger review habits, reproducible analysis, better documentation, and clearer storytelling.
- You have identified recurring reporting and manual processes that should be automated, consolidated, retired, or moved into governed self-service.
- You are personally presenting insights and recommendations to senior leaders or client audiences and helping the team do the same with confidence.

By twelve months
- Measurable time has shifted from manual reporting assembly into analysis, advisory work, and higher-value decision support.
- The team’s Power BI and Fabric assets are more standardized, governed, better documented, and easier for stakeholders to trust and use.
- At least one analyst has grown into materially more complex work through your coaching and development.
- The team is engaged earlier in business decisions, helping shape the question rather than only responding after the request is fully defined.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Management, or a related quantitative field; equivalent work experience may be considered.
- 7+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data management, research, or a related data-focused field.
- 2+ years of experience formally leading, supervising, or managing analysts, or equivalent experience leading analytical work through others.
- Demonstrated ability to translate complex analysis into recommendations that influence business decisions.
- Experience leading analytical projects from intake and scoping through delivery, presentation, adoption, and follow-up.
- Experience managing competing stakeholder priorities, team capacity, timelines, quality standards, and delivery expectations.

Technical requirements
- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning, data validation, and the ability to work directly with enterprise data warehouses.
- Strong Power BI experience, including data modeling, star schema design, DAX, semantic model development, row-level security, report performance tuning, and governed self-service analytics.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse/Warehouse concepts, Direct Lake, pipelines, notebooks, or comparable experience with modern cloud/lakehouse analytics platforms.
- Strong understanding of data quality, data governance, metric consistency, documentation, access controls, and reporting reliability.
- Advanced Excel skills and comfort using modern analytics, automation, and AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and documentation.

Communication and data storytelling
- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, non-technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and client audiences.
- Strong data storytelling skills, including the ability to simplify complex or ambiguous findings into clear messages, business implications, and recommended actions.
- Executive presence and confidence presenting to, advising, and being challenged by senior leaders and external stakeholders.
- Ability to build trust, influence decisions, manage tradeoffs, and keep stakeholders aligned when priorities shift.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

- Master’s degree in business, analytics, statistics, applied mathematics, operations research, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
- Experience in insurance, telecommunications, retail, warranty, service operations, client operations, or other data-rich operational environments.
- Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Azure, Python, R, predictive modeling, time series forecasting, segmentation, cluster analysis, retention analysis, or exploratory analytics.
- Experience modernizing legacy reporting, consolidating dashboards, defining KPI frameworks, improving semantic models, and increasing adoption of trusted analytics products.
- Experience with Agile delivery, product ownership, portfolio prioritization, user acceptance testing, release management, or change management for analytics solutions.
- Hands-on use of AI-assisted coding, documentation, or analytics tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring work, or build internal tooling responsibly.
- A track record of developing talent, leading through influence, and creating a culture of curiosity, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: People Partner
jobs.description:
Overview of Position

We are growing in Irving, Texas! Assurant is seeking a People Partner who will provide Human Resource support to managers and employees in designated segments in one of Assurant Lines of businesses (LOB) focusing on the employee experience, enabling business outcomes, and using data to help make solid business decisions.

In partnership with the People Business Partner, you will provide comprehensive and consistent coaching to employees and managers on performance and conduct/behavioral related challenges. This will include answering questions and listening to concerns about the workplace and jobs. The Partner will also work with the Business Partner to assist the LOB in identifying people and talent needs in the organization through the application of talent program and processes.

This role espouses the vision of the People Organization by:
- Putting people first

- Helping our employees realize their potential

- Empowering our employees to do their best work

- Embedding Diversity Equity and Inclusion in all that we do

- Living The Assurant Commitments in all that we do

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?
- Focus on the employee experience, provide proactive and reactive coaching and consultative human resources advice and services to all employees of Assurant in their designated business unit from intake to resolution.

- Coaching and advice are centered around and leverages the core learnings of Success in Leading Employees (i.e., StAR/StAR-AR, GROW) as they counsel on Performance Development and Performance Improvement situations.

- Build and maintain strong working relationships with Managers and with the People Business Partners for their client group.

- Provide hiring & staffing assistance such as interviewing, assessing and selection to managers as needed. Including effective compensation management and development of job descriptions for needed positions.

- Partner with managers in client group in their efforts around Employee Engagement that could include action planning, team meetings and follow-up to ensure closure on plans.

- Provide performance coaching and advice which may include participation in meetings with employees and managers.

- Provide advice on policy interpretation with the focus on advising managers to always use their judgment and discretion. The Partner will leverage the Success in Leading Employees information in their interactions with managers and promote the use of this information to the Managers.

- Provide education and training to managers as needed in areas such as FMLA, Union Avoidance, Wage and Hour, Accommodations etc. Collaboratively makes decisions about training needed by consulting with managers, Legal and/or People Business Partner.

- Performs consultation responsibilities to assist managers & leaders in the termination process whether a reduction in force or a voluntary or involuntary termination including participating in any termination meeting with employees.

- Facilitates the end-to-end process of the reduction in force in consultation with the People Business Partner and Business leadership. This will include the assessment of talent, notification to impacted associates and continued support to those employees after notification.

- Performs more routine inquiries, research or investigation into issues raised by employees, managers, or other sources.

- Participates in additional projects as identified by the People Organization leadership.

- Utilize multiple tools (Workday, Peakon, ERIN, etc.) to mine data for their client groups and use the analytics to drive performance in the organization.

- Recommend updates and suggestions to the content in the Knowledge Base and in the analytics that will improve the content available to them and to the managers.

- Develop and maintain relationships with members of the People Experience Center team to expedite and ensure that employee and manager concerns or requests which have been escalated are responded to in a timely, consistent, and accurate manner as well as documented appropriately.

What are the requirements needed for this position?
- Bachelor’s degree in a related area

- A minimum of 2 years of experience in a Human Resource professional role.

- Experience must include coaching and advising all levels of employees in areas such as performance, organizational change, employee engagement, working relationships.

- Knowledge of employment law at the federal and state level (FMLA, ADA, FLSA, Title VII, EEO and other applicable employment related laws)

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?
- Extensive analytical and problem-solving skills desired.

- Certification as PHR, SPHR or SHRM CP or SCP preferred.

- Experience in handling employee related investigations and writing report summaries.

- Minimum of 1 year HR support for a workforce of a minimum of 250 employees.

jobs.title: People Partner
jobs.description:
The People Partner provides human resources support to managers and employees in designated segments in one or more Assurant Lines of businesses (LOB) Focusing on the employee experience, enabling business outcomes, and using data to help make solid business decisions.

The People Partner, in partnership with the People Business Partner, provides   comprehensive and consistent coaching and counseling services to employees and managers on performance and conduct/behavioral related challenges; answering questions and listening to concerns about the workplace and jobs.  The Partner will also work with the Business Partner to assist the LOB in identifying people and talent needs in the organization through the application of talent program and processes.

The People Partner may be involved in requests to investigate situations that may require investigation or have a sense of urgency to resolve. Those requests may come from employees, managers, Legal, the People Experience Center etc.    In addition, the People Partner will proactively work with People Business Partners, managers & leaders in the People Experience center, providing insights and trends that impact the achievement of business results.

The feedback and coaching provided by the People Partner will model and reinforce the learnings of Success in Leading Employees to enable managers to leverage their discretion in judgment to determine the most appropriate course of action while continuing to focus on the employee experience. To this end he or she will promote The Assurant Way in their approach to policies, procedures, and practices to minimize risk to the company.

Creating and maintaining strong relationships will be critical to success as the People Partner will serve as a key resource to managers and People Business partners.  In this capacity the People Partner may provide training to managers on topics that will enhance engagement or provide greater insights into management of people resources to support business objectives. Relationships with the other COE’s in the People Organization such as Talent Acquisition and the People Experience Center, will be vital to the success of this role

This role espouses the vision of the People Organization by:

·       Putting people first
·       Helping our employees realize their potential
·       Empowering our employees to do their best work
·       Embedding Diversity Equity and Inclusion in all that we do

·       Provides hiring & staffing assistance such as interviewing, assessing and selection to managers as needed.  Including effective compensation management and development of job descriptions for needed positions.

·       Performs consultation responsibilities to assist managers & leaders in the termination process whether a reduction in force or a voluntary or involuntary termination including participating in any termination meeting with employees.
·       Facilitates the end-to-end process of the reduction in force in consultation with the People Business Partner and Business leadership. This will include the assessment of talent, notification to impacted associates and continued support to those employees after notification.
·       Performs more routine inquiries, research or investigation into issues raised by employees, managers, or other sources.
·       Participates in additional projects as identified by the People Organization leadership.

2.     The People Partner leverages NeoCase/ ERIN, to document and manage the types of situations that come to them from managers and employees.  The Partner will use multiple tools (Workday, Peakon, ERIN, etc.) to mine data for their client groups and use the analytics to drive performance in the organization. - Bachelor’s degree in a related area with 1 yrs. experience in an HR professional role or a minimum of 4 years’ experience in an HR professional role or managing people.  Experience must include coaching and advising all levels of employees in areas such as performance, organizational change, employee engagement, working relationships.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview of Position
The Business Intelligence Solutions Specialist supports Legal and Compliance operations by designing, developing, and implementing data-driven solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance. This role partners closely with Legal, Compliance, IT, and third-party vendors to translate business requirements into reporting, analytics, automation, and technology solutions.
The position serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, developing business intelligence solutions, supporting data integrations, driving automation initiatives, and leading projects that enhance operational effectiveness. The Business Intelligence Solutions Specialist leverages Power BI, SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, APIs, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence solutions, to deliver measurable business value and continuous improvement.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Business Intelligence & Analytics
- Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide actionable business insights and support strategic decision-making.
- Design and maintain data models that support accurate, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
- Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
- Develop reporting solutions and KPIs that measure operational performance and support business objectives.
- Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of reporting and analytics outputs.
- Implement and maintain appropriate data access controls, including Power BI row-level security, workspace permissions, and other measures to protect sensitive or confidential information.
- Support the development lifecycle of business intelligence solutions and projects, including requirements, development, testing, deployment, workspace management, scheduled refreshes, production releases, and ongoing enhancements.

Data Integration & Automation
- Develop and support ETL processes to integrate, cleanse, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analytics.
- Utilize Power Query and related tools to combine and optimize data from multiple sources.
- Build, support, and enhance automated workflows using Power Automate and other automation technologies.
- Support and maintain integrations between enterprise systems using APIs and other connectivity methods.
- Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve operational efficiency through automation and technology solutions.
- Maintain technical documentation for data sources, data models, integrations, APIs, automation workflows, dependencies, and solution configurations.

Business Partnership & Solution Delivery
- Partner with stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, IT, and external vendors to gather and document business requirements.
- Translate business needs into reporting, analytics, automation, and technology solutions.
- Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
- Coordinate system testing activities, including functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
- Develop training materials and support user adoption of new processes, systems, and reporting solutions.

Project & Process Improvement
- Lead and support business intelligence, automation, and process improvement initiatives from planning through implementation.
- Develop project plans, coordinate activities, monitor timelines, and manage risks to ensure successful delivery.
- Analyze current-state business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and operational improvement.

jobs.description:
The VP, Business Development is a senior commercial hunter responsible for securing net-new Financial Services client partnerships that drive profitable revenue and EBITDA growth for Assurant. This role is focused on identifying, originating, shaping, negotiating, and closing complex, multiyear commercial agreements with targeted Financial Services prospects across card benefits, retail travel, legal services/insurance, identity theft protection, and adjacent customer value-added services.

This is not a transactional sales role.  This is a new-sales leadership role, not an account management or renewal ownership role. The VP will own the external pursuit strategy and full deal lifecycle for prospective clients — from target identification, executive outreach, discovery, solution development, commercial structuring, negotiation support, contracting, and close.   The role will partner closely with the appropriate Line of Business leader, Finance, Legal, Product, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to structure economically sound, executable client solutions.

The VP serves as a commercial architect and closer — building senior-level prospect relationships, creating urgency, aligning Assurant’s enterprise capabilities to client growth priorities, and positioning Assurant as a strategic partner for new Financial Services clients.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Financial Services Growth & New Client Acquisition
- Originate and close new partnerships across targeted net-new Financial Services prospects across card benefits, retail travel, legal services, identity theft protection, and adjacent customer value-added services.
- Personally build and own a targeted prospecting strategy, including market mapping, target lists, outbound executive outreach, industry networking, referrals, and pursuit prioritization
- Own the full deal lifecycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design, executive engagement, negotiation, contracting, and close.
- Build and maintain a disciplined business development funnel, using Salesforce and dashboards to track opportunity health and outcomes.
- Create account pursuit plans for priority prospects, including stakeholder mapping, value hypothesis, buying triggers, competitive positioning, next-best actions, and path-to-close.
- Apply disciplined deal qualification to ensure resources are focused on opportunities with strong strategic, financial, operational, and timing fit.

Full Deal Lifecycle Ownership & Close Execution
- Lead discovery with prospective clients to uncover business priorities, customer experience gaps, revenue opportunities, operational requirements, and decision criteria.
- Shape differentiated value propositions that connect client needs to Assurant capabilities and clearly articulate client economics, customer value, and Assurant profitability.
- Drive executive engagement and maintain momentum through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
- Lead internal deal reviews, opportunity strategy sessions, and close plans to accelerate decision-making and improve conversion.
- Maintain accountability for moving qualified prospects from first meeting to signed agreement.

Client Expansion & Relationship Deepening
- Secondary Growth Opportunities: While the primary focus of this role is net-new client acquisition, the VP may identify expansion opportunities within recently acquired or strategically targeted relationships when those opportunities support new revenue, new product adoption, or broader enterprise growth. Ongoing account management, renewal ownership, and day-to-day client relationship management will remain with the appropriate account leadership teams.

Commercial Structuring & Contract Negotiation Partnership
- Partner with the relevant Line of Business leader on commercial strategy, pricing structure, deal economics, and negotiation approach for prospective client agreements.
- Lead the business development workstream in client negotiations, while collaborating with the LOB leader, Finance, Legal, Product, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to ensure proposed terms are commercially attractive, legally sound, operationally executable, and aligned to Assurant’s financial objectives.
- Translate prospect requirements into deal structures that balance client outcomes, Assurant profitability, risk management, implementation feasibility, and long-term partnership value.
- Support negotiation of complex multiyear agreements, including scope, pricing, service levels, performance commitments, implementation timelines, governance, and renewal/expansion pathways.
- Maintain accountability for progressing opportunities to signed agreement while ensuring appropriate internal approvals and stakeholder alignment.

Solution Leadership & Cross Functional Orchestration
- Orchestrate internal teams to co-create prospect-specific solutions that are differentiated, executable, scalable, and aligned to Assurant’s growth strategy.
- Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and the relevant LOB leader to validate solution feasibility, economics, implementation requirements, and risk considerations
- Ensure solutions are executable, scalable, and aligned to Assurant’s five-year strategy and growth roadmap.
- Ensure new-client proposals translate clearly into operating models, launch plans, financial assumptions, and contractual commitments.
- Remove internal barriers, drive decisions, and maintain momentum across matrixed teams during active pursuits.

Enterprise Growth & “Connect the Dots”
- Champion enterprise-wide growth by connecting Assurant capabilities across divisions to unlock new revenue streams for the business.
- Lead/participate in cross functional Business Development forums to share best practices, improve funnel efficiency, and accelerate innovation.
- Bring a P&L mindset to every opportunity, balancing growth, profitability, and long-term partnership value.

Financial Responsibility
- Accountable for driving Financial Services revenue and EBITDA growth through net-new client acquisition, qualified pipeline creation, conversion of targeted prospects, and launch of newly secured client partnerships.
- Partners with the relevant Line of Business leader and Finance, Legal, Product, Risk, Compliance, and Operations on commercial structuring, pricing strategy, deal economics, approvals, and negotiation strategy for prospective client agreements.
- Manages and influences business development–related budgets.

Market Intelligence, Competitive Positioning & Executive Influence
- Maintain a strong understanding of Financial Services market dynamics, competitive offerings, buyer priorities, and emerging client needs.
- Develop executive-level narratives and pursuit messaging that differentiate Assurant in competitive new-business opportunities.
- Represent Assurant externally at client meetings, conferences, industry events, and strategic networking forums to identify and advance new sales opportunities.

Leadership & Talent Development
- Lead, mentor, and inspire BD talent and matrixed teams, setting a high bar for performance, accountability, and execution.
- Model Assurant’s values and represent the brand with credibility and consistency across Assurant and the Financial Services ecosystem.

What are the requirements needed for this position?
- 15+ years of progressive business development, enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, or commercial growth experience.
- Direct experience selling or structuring complex solutions in Financial Services, card benefits, protection products, retail travel, legal services, identity protection, customer experience, or adjacent regulated-market solutions.
- Proven hunter profile with experience building target lists, creating outbound pursuit strategies, developing executive relationships, and converting qualified pipeline into signed multiyear contracts.
- Demonstrated success as a hunter—originating, negotiating, and closing complex, multi‑year commercial deals.
- Experience partnering with Line of Business leaders, Finance, Legal, Product, Operations, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to structure commercially sound and operationally executable client agreements.
- Proven experience leading cross-functional teams to design and deliver client specific solutions.
- Deep experience in complex contracting, deal structuring, and negotiation, including financial, legal, and operational dimensions.
- Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage pipeline, forecast opportunity progression, inspect deal health, and drive accountability.
- MBA preferred
- Ability to rapidly synthesize complex client, market, and enterprise inputs into a clear growth narrative that resonates with clients and aligns internal teams around a shared vision.
- Demonstrated skill in leading outcomes across highly matrixed organizations by aligning stakeholders, resolving tradeoffs, and driving decisions without direct control.
- Strong instinct for prioritizing the right opportunities, structuring pragmatic solutions, and making sound tradeoffs in fastmoving, high stakes deal environments with incomplete information.
- Experience developing executive-level value messaging for competitive pursuits involving complex solutions, regulated environments, or multi-stakeholder buying groups.
- Ability to travel up to 60% domestically for client meetings, executive presentations, negotiations, and industry events, as business needs require.

Core Competencies:
- Strategic growth mindset with the ability to connect client needs to enterprise capabilities
- Advanced commercial and financial acumen, including P&L ownership
- Executive level communication and influence with C-suite and senior leaders
- Hunter/closer orientation with a demonstrated ability to personally create, advance, and close new-business opportunities.
- Strategic pipeline builder with disciplined funnel management, qualification rigor, and forecast accountability.
- Commercial architect with strong judgment in structuring deals that balance client value, profitability, operational feasibility, and risk.
- Strong solution orientation—able to go beyond selling to building and delivering
- High energy, hungry, dynamic, and resilient, with a bias toward action and results
- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and drive outcomes across matrixed organizations.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:
- Net-new Financial Services clients acquired.
- Qualified new-logo pipeline created, advanced, and converted.
- Complex multi-year agreements signed with targeted prospects.
- Measurable revenue and EBITDA contribution from newly secured client relationships.
- New-client revenue launched across growth product lines.
- Strong client satisfaction and executive level trust
- Repeatable, scalable solutions launched through cross functional execution
- Internal institutional knowledge, high-engagement, and trust
- Accurate forecasting, disciplined funnel management, and consistent opportunity progression.
